messages:
lee-docs: Quick sync  there's a small docs PR that fixes a broken anchor in the migration guide and adds an SDK auth example. Need it merged before the 2.8 docs cutoff (Fri 2026-03-26 16:00 PT) if we want it in the scheduled minor. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2380
nina-platform: I can eyeball layout and the code snippet later today. Is the change behind a runtime feature flag?
omar-eng: Not behind a flag. It's docs-only but mentions Dedicated deployment details (baseUrl behavior). I updated the snippet locally to show env fallback and a one-line note about baseUrl for private installs.
sam-plt: I'll do a quick API review tonight. If CI preview is green I'll /approve tomorrow morning.
ci-bot: preview build started for PR 2380 (job 4910). Preview: https://deploy-preview-2380--docs.redwood.ai/ (build logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4910) :gear:
lee-docs: Note: the preview initially hid the version selector for this branch; clearing preview cache fixed it for me. If you don't see the correct nav, append ?clear_cache=1 to the preview URL.
release-coordinator: If it lands after the cutoff we can always ship as a docs patch, but we prefer to include it in the minor to avoid churn. Please target merge at least 24h before cutoff so release notes can include it.
omar-eng: I pushed the env fallback snippet and the baseUrl note. Also added a short migration-step example for teams moving from legacy auth to apiKey.
sam-plt: API check done. Snippet matches runtime surface and the migration step is accurate. I'll /approve after CI passes.
ci-bot: build 4910 passed. Lighthouse checks ok.
lee-docs: Excellent. Sam, when you approve please merge and add the PR link to the release notes draft. I'll open a tiny follow-up if any docs wording needs smoothing post-merge.
sam-plt: Approved and merged. Merged at 2026-03-23T02:00Z.
release-coordinator: Noted  added to 2.8 release notes. Thanks everyone.
lee-docs: Closing loop. If any customers report confusion about baseUrl on Dedicated, we'll add an explicit example in the private deployment guide. Thanks all!
